coaching.title: Active Recovery + Light Strength
coaching.message: 11 days out, taper is on. Calendar has this as a recovery day: 20-30 min very easy jog or walk, Zone 1 only (HR well under 138 bpm), then one last light strength session — single-leg work, hips, core, low volume. This isn't the day to chase fitness. Freshness for the Julian Alps' 2,500m of vert matters more right now than one more hard session.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: Light training load today, so keep carbs near the ~220g rest-day target rather than loading up — volume is dropping but you still need the glycogen for muscle repair from the strength work. Prioritize protein (25-30g per meal) for recovery, and use any easy run minutes to rehearse race-day fueling rhythm (sip fluids every 15-20 min) so gut and legs stay in sync for the 60-80g carbs/hr you'll need on course.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Post-strength: 10 min mobility focused on hips and ankles (alpine terrain punishes stiff ankles), then foam roll quads and calves. Target 8+ hours of sleep tonight — you're mid-travel, so protect the sleep window even if the schedule around you is chaotic. No run over 90 minutes for the rest of the taper, full stop.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: The taper is the hard part for the mind, not the legs — the fitness is banked, now it's about trusting it. Use today's easy jog to mentally walk the Julian Alps course: the climbs, the weather that can turn fast in the Slovenian Alps, and your pacing plan for the descents. Patience now is what lets you run strong on the 18th.
